_about: Labeled synthetic Apex corpus for measuring the heuristic SAST recognizers' false-positive / false-negative rates. Every snippet is invented (no real org). `shouldFire` is the ground-truth label for the case's target `rule`. Cases deliberately include FP-traps (looks like a hit but isn't) and FN-blindspots (a real issue the documented heuristic boundary misses — dynamic SOQL, cross-method, etc.) so the measured number is honest, not gamed. Expand freely. Measure: `node eval/sast-accuracy.mjs`.
